baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causal fa links the divine curse to two causative sensory verbs, while the possessed faculty of sight is named separately.
baseline_models.mechanism: Expulsion from good is enacted inside the person as loss of access: sound no longer becomes heed, and vision no longer becomes insight. The three clauses form one exclusion mechanism rather than a list of unrelated penalties.

activation_trace.role: The curse supplies removal from favor and makes exclusion the governing operation of the verse.
The divine name locates the causative acts within the authority to which worship and response are owed.
Loss of hearing together with refusal to heed turns exclusion into failed reception.
Loss of inward discrimination extends blindness from the eye to orientation toward truth.
The explicitly possessed sights are treated as capacities for penetrating recognition, not only organs.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists cursing, deafness, and blindness as three punishments.
changed_reading.after: The curse is operationalized as sensory and cognitive exile: the channels by which guidance could reach and orient them are removed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative deafening and blinding converge on the named receptive faculties.
baseline_models.mechanism: Deafness supplies a stopped opening, while blinding supplies imposed obscurity. Hearing and sight remain grammatically present but cease to admit or clarify anything, producing a sealed receptor rather than simple absence.

activation_trace.role: Removal of a gap gives deafening the material geometry of an aperture stopped shut.
Imposed confusion supplies the obscuring layer on the visual side of the closure.
Ordinary ocular sight keeps the model anchored in the verse's explicit sensory object.

changed_reading.before: The people simply lack two senses.
changed_reading.after: Their receptive openings are present but stopped and obscured, so incoming address cannot become perception.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two causatives can be tested against focus-root branches of determined non-listening and exclusive aim.
baseline_models.mechanism: Deafness can depict proceeding without taking correction, while blindness can depict aiming at one option to the exclusion of all others. The judgment then hardens a chosen course into incapacity without erasing the surface reading of imposed sensory loss.

activation_trace.role: Resolute onward movement without heeding restraint makes deafness a pattern of locked-in conduct.
Exclusive choice and aim make blindness a narrowing onto one selected course.
Insight is the capacity lost when selection excludes corrective alternatives.

changed_reading.before: The sensory loss is wholly passive and arrives without relation to a prior orientation.
changed_reading.after: The imposed loss may also be the hardened endpoint of non-listening and exclusive aim, where a course becomes unable to revise itself.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The blindness root offers both enveloping obscurity and land without signs, while the sight noun keeps navigation tied to perception.
baseline_models.mechanism: The curse can spatialize sensory exile: the person is not merely an eye that fails but a traveler enclosed in obscurity and deprived of landmarks. Deaf closure removes incoming bearings; blinded sight removes the field by which a route could be read.

activation_trace.role: Expulsion supplies the movement away from a protected and orienting domain.
A stopped opening removes bearings that might arrive from outside.
Enveloping darkness supplies the medium that occludes the traveler's field.
Unmarked terrain makes loss of sight a loss of navigable signs rather than only retinal function.
The named visual faculty remains the concrete means by which terrain would be read.

changed_reading.before: Blindness is localized in the individual's eyes.
changed_reading.after: Blindness also renders the surrounding moral world trackless: no opening supplies bearings and no landmark becomes a route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence repeatedly combines covering, active diversion, a traversable way, and lost direction; the later recurrence says obstruction persists after guidance is exposed. The focus closure can therefore be read as the geometry of outward obstruction folded inward onto the obstructers' own faculties.

activation_trace.role: The sealed aperture is the inward endpoint of the context's blocking geometry.
Imposed obscurity turns external concealment into an internal inability to discriminate.
Concealing what is true supplies the covering action that later returns upon perception.
Active turning and diversion supply the outward action mirrored by inward sensory refusal.
A route meant to be traversed gives obstruction a directional object.
Departure from right direction supplies the failed outcome of the blocked route.
The repeated diversion shows that obstruction is sustained rather than momentary.
Disclosure removes lack of available evidence as the explanation for continued obstruction.
Gentle direction toward a true route identifies what their closed faculties no longer receive.

structural_cues: 47:1 puts covering, diversion, route, and misdirection in one causal chain.
47:32 repeats diversion after explicit disclosure and direction, creating a reversal back toward the focus faculties.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outward covering and diversion before and after clear direction; I supply the reciprocal arrow by which that obstruction becomes inward closure. A live alternative is that the sensory loss is a separate divine sanction rather than a mirrored consequence.

changed_reading.before: The curse independently disables hearing and sight.
changed_reading.after: The disability mirrors their own obstruction: the route they blocked outside becomes a blocked route into their own hearing and seeing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance, travel, directed looking, and a named way turn the trackless-land baseline into a pericope-wide navigation model. Blinded sights fail not only to register objects but to read routes, precedents, and destinations from the world.

activation_trace.role: Land without readable signs supplies the focus model's spatial form of blindness.
Penetrating discernment is the faculty required to turn seen traces into orientation.
Direction toward a true path supplies the positive counterpart to tracklessness.
Movement through the land makes orientation an enacted task rather than an abstract idea.
Directed ocular and inward attention is the means for reading prior outcomes.
The recurring traversable way confirms that the missing capacity is route-reading.

structural_cues: 47:5 promises direction, while 47:10 commands travel and inspection of prior outcomes.
The focus stands between severed social routes and the demand to contemplate, so navigation remains both spatial and cognitive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direction, travel, looking, and routes; I infer that their combination turns the focus blindness into loss of landmark-reading. The alternative is ordinary inner blindness with no spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The blinded faculty cannot see what is in front of it.
changed_reading.after: The blinded faculty cannot convert visible history and available paths into a route, leaving the moral terrain effectively unmarked.

context_deltas.mechanism: Protective nearness, turning away, severed kinship, rejected approval, and replacement specify the curse as relational excision. The sensory losses then mark inability to receive or recognize bonds after the agents have broken the bonds they were responsible to maintain.

activation_trace.role: Expulsion from favor supplies the relational center of the curse.
Protective love and support define the nearness from which exclusion removes a party.
Turning away supplies the agents' relational motion immediately before the focus judgment.
Deliberate rupture of connection gives the preceding conduct the same separating geometry as the curse.
Kinship names the concrete bond that their turning and cutting destroy.
Abundant divine approval identifies the positive relation they actively reject.
Substitution turns exclusion into loss of a functional place that another can occupy.
A successor people makes the consequence corporate as well as individual.

structural_cues: 47:11 contrasts protective affiliation with its absence; 47:22 places turning away and severed kinship directly before the focus.
47:28 names rejected approval, and 47:38 ends with replacement by another people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protective affiliation, rupture, rejected approval, and replacement; I infer that the curse is the relational excision connecting them. The alternative is that these are separate social offenses and eschatological consequences without one mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The curse is generic removal from good.
changed_reading.after: The curse removes protective nearness and communal place after bonds are turned from and cut, culminating in replaceability by another people.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distinguishes acoustic exposure from understanding, then places a seal on hearts, depicts a death-covered gaze, and follows the focus with failed contemplation and locks. Deafness and blindness become failures in a perception-to-heart-to-response circuit rather than proof that no sound or image reached the body.

activation_trace.role: Failure to heed lets deafness name a breakdown after sound reaches the listener.
Blindness of discernment locates the visual failure in the inward processor.
Insight names the conversion from visible material to recognized truth.
Understanding and compliance distinguish effective hearing from mere acoustic attendance.
An impressed seal supplies the mechanism by which received material fails to penetrate.
The heart identifies the processing center on which the seal operates.
Directed sight remains physically active even while its response is distorted by fear.
A covering that overwhelms awareness supplies the bridge from active looking to non-processing.
Considering consequences names the cognitive operation the closed circuit fails to perform.
Hard closure on the heart confirms that the sensory blockage terminates in cognition.

structural_cues: 47:16 presents listeners who hear and then ask what was said before naming sealed hearts.
47:20 supplies active but death-like looking, and 47:24 immediately recasts the focus problem as failed contemplation with locked hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hearing without understanding, sealed hearts, active but overwhelmed looking, and locked contemplation; I infer a single processing circuit connecting them. Literal sensory punishment remains a live concurrent reading rather than being canceled.

changed_reading.before: The ears and eyes fail at the point of physical input.
changed_reading.after: Input occurs, but the sealed heart cannot convert sound and sight into understanding, deliberation, or obedient response.

context_deltas.mechanism: A less conservative branch of the adjacent lock gathers vision onto one object; the next ayah describes reversal after disclosure and decorated desire, followed by allegiance to what provokes anger and aversion to approval. The focus may therefore describe attentional capture: not blank perception, but a field narrowed until correction cannot enter.

activation_trace.role: Proceeding without listening supplies the behavioral persistence of captured attention.
Aiming at one thing to the exclusion of others supplies the narrowing operation.
Insight is what selective fixation prevents despite continued exposure.
Visual following and collection around one object activate a lock that concentrates as well as closes.
A defect that turns back sight or speech gives reversal a direct sensory echo.
Prior disclosure shows that narrowing happens despite available clarity.
Desire's beautification supplies the attractor around which attention closes.
Sustained allegiance turns an initial attraction into a continuing course.
Divine anger identifies the endpoint selected by that continuing allegiance.
Rejected approval supplies the excluded alternative that the narrowed field no longer values.

structural_cues: The lock question at 47:24 is followed immediately by reversal after clarity and by prolonged self-decoration at 47:25.
47:28 restates the polarity as followed anger-producing conduct versus hated approval.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a visual-gathering branch for the lock, reversal after clarity, beautified desire, and polarized allegiance; I infer the arrow from attraction to attentional capture. The materially live alternative is simple closure under the lock's more ordinary branch.

changed_reading.before: Hardening means stubborn motion with no further internal structure.
changed_reading.after: Hardening can be selective capture: attention gathers around a decorated course until hearing and sight exclude every corrective alternative.

context_deltas.mechanism: After their sights are blinded, hidden contents are threatened with emergence, the group can be shown and recognized by marks and inflected speech, and testing exposes their reports. Visibility is redistributed: their capacity to read truth contracts while their own concealed state becomes increasingly readable to God and observers.

activation_trace.role: Obscuration anchors the loss on the group's side of the perceptual relation.
Failed penetrating recognition contrasts with the successful recognition of them by others.
Bringing concealed material outward initiates the reversal from hidden interior to public evidence.
Causing them to be seen makes their visibility depend on divine disclosure rather than their self-presentation.
Recognition from trace or sign makes their condition diagnostically legible.
A visible indication carries inner condition onto outward appearance.
The slant of speech exposes meaning to a listener even without an explicit confession.
Testing makes a latent condition manifest through enacted evidence.
Knowledge of inward reality names what the testing process brings into view.

structural_cues: The branchless root ض غ ن at 47:29 and 47:37 supplies only the sequence of concealed content and its extraction; no branch ID is assigned to it.
47:30 moves from possible divine showing to human recognition by appearance and speech, then 47:31 moves to testing and exposed reports.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden content, disclosure, recognition, outward signs, audible inflection, and testing; I infer a redistribution in which their blindness coincides with their own increased legibility. The alternative is that detection of them is independent of the focus sensory judgment.

changed_reading.before: Blindness creates a generally dark scene in which less can be known.
changed_reading.after: Blindness is asymmetric: they lose the power to read truth while their own hidden state becomes more readable to others.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the agricultural deterrent branch of the curse root rather than its ordinary exclusion sense. It remains anchored to the focus curse and its deictic subjects, while 47:10 makes destroyed predecessors objects of inspection and warning; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary displayed-deterrence image, never as a lexical replacement for cursing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The demonstrative subjects and the curse root allow the judged group to be tested as a visible warning-object for later viewers.

activation_trace.role: An erected field deterrent supplies the strange image of the cursed group as a figure whose displayed state drives others away.
Directed seeing makes prior destruction something observers are expected to inspect.
Comprehensive ruin supplies the visible condition carried by the warning figure.
An exemplary sign turns the ruined condition into guidance for a later observer.

changed_reading.before: The cursed are only expelled objects of judgment.
changed_reading.after: Their judged condition may also be displayed as a deterrent figure that redirects the sight of observers even while their own sight is blinded.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material reading is surprising because it links a highly specific thick-liquid branch of the deafness root to the surah's flowing milk and messenger imagery. The focus root, the explicit milk river, and the continuous-yield branch under the messenger root keep it traceable; downstream prose should qualify it as an analogy for failed transmission, not claim that the focus verb literally denotes milk.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The causative deafening root includes a material state in which thickened liquid falls without audible impact.

activation_trace.role: A thickened pour that produces no audible impact supplies the receiver's non-flowing, non-resonant endpoint.
Channels cut through land by moving water supply sustained flow as the positive material contrast.
The explicit drinkable milk makes the focus root's thick-liquid branch contextually activated rather than free association.
Change of state sharpens the contrast between an unaltered provision and a receiver that has materially thickened.
A continuous yield under the messenger root lets transmitted guidance be imagined as a medium meant to keep arriving.

changed_reading.before: Deafness is simply failure to detect sound.
changed_reading.after: Deafness can be pictured as reception curdling: continuous delivery reaches a medium that no longer flows or resonates.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates a leather-joining sense under the sight root against an overtly visual surface. It remains anchored to the named sights and is sharply triggered by the immediately preceding cutting of kinship; downstream prose should retain ordinary blindness as primary and offer the seam image only as a material analogy for failed relational perception and repair.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The explicitly named sight faculty has a branch involving edges and joining divided pieces.

activation_trace.role: Joining two edges supplies a material model for perceiving and repairing a relation across a division.
Rupture of connection supplies the cut whose edges the focus faculty can no longer recognize or rejoin.
Kinship identifies the divided material as a living social bond rather than an abstract seam.

changed_reading.before: Blinded sights cannot recognize visual truth.
changed_reading.after: Blinded sights may also be unable to perceive relational edges as joinable, mirroring the prior cutting of kinship.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it activates the extreme-miser branch of the deafness root and maps sensory closure onto economic refusal. It remains anchored to the focus deafening and to the repeated late sequence of pressured request, withholding, expenditure, and self-effect; downstream prose should frame it as a cross-domain closure analogy, not identify deafness with miserliness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A rare focus-root branch directly associates extreme withholding with the deafness root.

activation_trace.role: Extreme withholding turns the stopped ear into a broader model of refusing circulation across a boundary.
Pressing a request to its limit tests whether the boundary will open.
Withholding supplies the explicit behavioral analogue of closure under pressure.
A verbal call tests auditory and volitional reception at the same time.
Material leaving its holder supplies the circulation that withholding blocks.
Triple repetition makes closed-handed refusal a sustained pattern rather than a passing reaction.
The self as the thing affected folds refusal back onto its holder, matching the inward-return mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Deafness closes only the incoming channel of sound.
changed_reading.after: The same closure can echo as a closed hand: neither corrective address nor entrusted wealth is allowed to circulate, and the refusal returns upon the self.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines a form-distant split mapping under the blindness root with an anatomical branch under the people root. Both are packet-authorized and remain anchored to the focus's literal blindness and the closing threat of replacing a people; downstream prose should present it only as a corporate-body echo, not as morphology that overrides the ordinary roots.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The causative blindness and possessed sights can be tested at corporate scale through the focus root's split inventory.

activation_trace.role: Literal loss of sight keeps the corporate extension anchored in the overt focus action.
The split inventory's group-wide scope permits testing whether blindness spreads across a collective body.
The possessed visual organ supplies the eye-function attributed to the collective.
One entity taking another's place turns failed perception into a succession mechanism.
A standing but sightless eye under the people root supplies the corporate image of an organized body whose seeing function has failed.

changed_reading.before: The verse concerns sensory loss in several individuals.
changed_reading.after: The group can also be pictured as a collective body that remains standing while its eye-function fails, making replacement by another people structurally intelligible.

strongest_changes: External covering and route-blocking turn inward as sealed hearing and obscured sight.
Actual listening and looking coexist with sealed hearts, so the primary failure lies in converting input into understanding and response.
The curse becomes relational excision from protection, kinship, approval, and eventually communal place.
Visibility becomes asymmetric: their own discernment contracts while their concealed condition becomes legible through signs, speech, and testing.
summary.what_was_special: The adjacent lock supported both ordinary closure and a live fixation reading, while distant but exact packet branches activated material flow-versus-curdling, closed-ear versus closed-hand, warning-figure, relational-seam, and collective-eye models without displacing the surface sensory judgment.
remaining_uncertainties: The causative verbs permit both fresh divine incapacitation and ratification of an already chosen orientation; the context supports but does not force one directional account.
The sight phrase can foreground ocular function, inward discernment, or both, and no retained model should erase that plurality.
The material, split-root, and rare-branch outliers are traceable analogies but remain too branch-distant to state as primary lexical senses.
